sources.title: Gemma 4 26b a4b: Google's Open-Source Reasoning Guide 2026
sources.snippet: The release of Google's latest open-source AI series has sent shockwaves through the development community, particularly with the introduction of the gemma 4 26b a4b model. Published on April 2, 2026, under the Apache 2.0 license, this model represents a massive leap in causal reasoning and complex logic.

sources.title: Quantized Models for google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it - Hugging Face
GotoAI-Inc/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-W4A16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: All model capabilities, evaluations and limitations belong to the original model card — see the base model for those. Unlike the 12B and 31B, Google publishes no qat-w4a16-ct build at this size. Its own 4-bit release for the 26B A4B is qat-q4_0-gguf, which is llama.cpp-only, and NVIDIA's NVFP4 build needs a Blackwell card.
